package.name: cmd_to_can
package.description: Bridge from autoiq_msgs/VehicleControl (produced by the control package) to the Teensy 4.1 over the CAN bus. Uses the same wire protocol as firmware/main_project/src/compute_side_tui.py: throttle/mode/steer-angle frames on standard 11-bit IDs, plus the new 0x304 velocity-setpoint frame so the Teensy can run an on-board velocity controller against the OBD feedback frame (extended ID 0x0C08A7F0).
